description: This file defines the Attribute class within the Opencart admin event controller namespace. It contains methods to hook into attribute edit and delete events to enqueue tasks for updating related product data.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: A controller class that listens to attribute edit and delete events to add background tasks for updating products related to specific attributes.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Event handler called after an attribute is edited. Retrieves products associated with the attribute and adds tasks to update their info.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Event handler called after an attribute is deleted. Retrieves related products and adds tasks similar to editAttribute.
